estrutura.ondeVazio: The moderators have not written the city yet.
estrutura.soLeituraTexto: Only the moderators start posts here.

respostasTexto.todos: Everyone can reply to the announcements.
respostasTexto.membros: Members of the community can reply to the announcements.

herancaTexto.mae: The moderators of {mae} also look after this place.

ajustar.intro: Only moderators see this part. Everything applies at once and is written on the tab for readers.
ajustar.reposts: Who can bring posts from another community here
ajustar.localAjuda: Write the municipality and, if you want, the neighborhood. We do not use the device's location or any outside map.
ajustar.maeAjuda: Write the address of the parent community (what comes after /c/). Its moderators get the request and decide. One level only: the parent does not live inside another, and a community that hosts subcommunities does not move inside another.
ajustar.naoPodeSerFilha: This community hosts subcommunities, so it does not move inside another.

herancaOpcoes.propria: Only our moderators look after this place
herancaOpcoes.mae: The parent community's moderators also look after this place

ajustar.herancaAjuda: With the second option, whoever moderates the parent also moderates this community with the same powers, while it lives there.
ajustar.pedidoFilha: {nome} wants to be a subcommunity of this one.
ajustar.pedidoFilhaHerda: {nome} wants to be a subcommunity of this one and wants the moderators here to look after it too.
ajustar.orgAjuda: Only organizations with a seal. Whoever manages the organization gets the request and decides.

espacos.intro: This organization's communities and local groups, in one place. Places appear here, never who takes part.
espacos.pedido: {nome} asked to appear in the Spaces.
espacos.semSelo: The Spaces show to everyone once the organization has a seal.

cidade.intro: Each community's moderators write the city and neighborhood. No device location.
cidade.vazio: No community has written its city yet.
cidade.escolha: Choose a municipality to see its communities.

levar.titulo: Take this post to another community
levar.intro: The post goes quoted, with its community of origin in view. Anyone there who cannot see the original only sees that it is restricted.
levar.semDestino: You are not yet in another community where you can post.
levar.comentarioExemplo: E.g.: This matters for our neighborhood too.

proposta.intro: If the community belongs to a city or neighborhood, write it here. If it will live inside another one, say which: its moderators decide after approval.
proposta.aviso: The proposal was sent, but the city or the parent community was not saved: {erro}

avisos.paraQuemLe: Only the moderators start posts here. You can reply to the notices, following the community's rule.
avisos.paraModeracao: Only the moderators (and roles allowed to) start posts here.

antes.soLeitura: This is an announcements community: only the moderators start posts here. You can reply to the announcements, according to the community's rule.

erros.so_leitura: This is an announcements community: only the moderators start posts here.
erros.so_leitura_respostas: In this announcements community, the rule does not let you reply.
erros.mae_e_filha: That community already lives inside another one; choose one that is not a subcommunity.
erros.filha_e_mae: This community hosts subcommunities and cannot live inside another one.
erros.sem_selo: Only organizations with a seal have Spaces.
erros.repostar_publico: This post belongs to a closed audience and does not leave its place.
erros.repostar_fechado: The destination community does not accept posts brought from elsewhere (or only from its moderators).
erros.mesma_comunidade: The post is already in that community.
erros.citar_fechado: The author of this post does not allow quotes.
erros.ja_decidida: The proposal has already been decided.
